summary_en: 550,000 shares (3.85% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired at ¥140/share via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-06-15. Total outlay up to ¥77.0M. Single-tranche buy at closing price; execution window limited to 08:45 JST trade window.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-auction dealing transactions (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-06-12, Japan Power Fastening Co., Ltd.'s board of directors resolved to acquire 550,000 treasury shares (3.85% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) via off-auction dealing transaction (ToSTNeT-3) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The company will place a buy order at the closing price of ¥140/share (as of 2026-06-12) on 2026-06-15 at 08:45 JST, with a total outlay ceiling of ¥77.0M. The order is limited to that single trading window only and execution results will be announced after market close that day. The stated rationale is to enhance capital efficiency, support flexible capital allocation responding to changing business conditions (specifically including the non-consolidation of a subsidiary disclosed separately that day), and improve the percentage and market value of floating shares in line with TSE listing maintenance standards. As of 2026-05-31, the company held 4,411,066 treasury shares against 14,277,474 shares outstanding excluding treasury. The company notes that a principal shareholder (Yuji Doi, a board advisor) has informed management of an intention to sell a portion of his shareholding, which could result in a change in principal shareholding disclosures.
